item.title: Anaheim Ducks Sign Herman Traff to Three-Year Entry-Level Contract | San Diego Gulls
item.description: The Anaheim Ducks announced today that the National Hockey League (NHL) club has signed right wing Herman Traff to a three-year entry-level contract beginning in the 2026-27 NHL season. Traff will join the San Diego Gulls, Anaheim's primary development affiliate in the American Hockey League, for the remainder of the 2025-26 season on an amateur tryout (ATO). item.title: Gaucher Hat Trick Leads Gulls to Victory | San Diego Gulls
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls added two more points to their record as they defeated the Calgary Wranglers tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 5-4. It was a monumental night for Nathan Gaucher as he recorded his first career AHL hat trick. The forward opened the scoring in the first, netted one in the second, and then put one more through on the empty net in the third.
